steps.en: Install the two binaries: the weave CLI and the weave-driver git will call
steps.zh: 安装 weave 与 weave-driver 两个二进制

steps.en: Register it for the repo; every supported extension gets a merge=weave rule
steps.zh: 每个仓库登记一次，受支持扩展名写上 merge=weave

steps.en: Merge, rebase or cherry-pick exactly as before — the workflow is unchanged
steps.zh: 照常 merge、rebase、cherry-pick——工作流一个字不改

steps.en: git hands over base/ours/theirs; each version is parsed into functions, classes and keys
steps.zh: git 递来三个版本，各自被解析成函数、类与键

steps.en: Independent entity edits merge clean; real collisions return markers naming the entity and guard
steps.zh: 不相干的实体改动自动合并；真冲突返回标记，写明实体与拒绝的守卫

steps.en: On a real conflict, read the per-entity detail, edit, then verify against the three git stages
steps.zh: 真冲突时看逐实体详情，改完再对三个 git 阶段校验

value.en: Independent edits to the same file stop halting merges — you only resolve actual semantic collisions
value.zh: 同一文件里互不相干的改动不再打断合并——你只处理真正的语义冲突

sources: README.md Quickstart: `weave setup` / `git merge <branch>` / `weave explain <file>` / `weave check`
README.md Setup: `weave setup` writes merge=weave rules to .gitattributes, derives them from the parser registry; --global/--local variants
README.md How It Works: parse base/ours/theirs into entities, match by identity, entity-level 3-way merge, reconstruct; fallback for >1MB/binary/unsupported
README.md Architecture: weave-driver is the binary git invokes (%O %A %B %L %P); weave-core holds entity extraction and the merge
README.md Conflict Markers: refused_by line names the internal guard that declined to auto-merge
